intro.data: Two queries read a record: its billing country and its shipping country. The equalizer is the sub-set of records where the two AGREE. Include a record from that matching set, then read either query — both give the same country. One inclusion lands in the matching set; the other lands on a record where billing and shipping differ, so the queries disagree and you can't reach the agreed answer. Pick the right inclusion and a query.
intro.alchemy: Two assays read a material: one by fire, one by acid. The equalizer is the batch on which the two AGREE. Include a sample from that matching batch, then run either assay — both give the same reading. One inclusion lands in the matching batch; the other lands where the assays differ. Pick the right inclusion and an assay.
intro.spellcraft: Two readings divine an essence: one by star, one by flame. The equalizer is the part on which the two AGREE. Include a mote from that matching part, then take either reading — both give the same sign. One inclusion lands in the matching part; the other where the readings differ. Pick the right inclusion and a reading.
intro.abstract: For parallel f, g : A → B, the equalizer e : E → A includes exactly the elements where f = g. Include an element of E, then apply f (or g) — they agree there. A non-equalizing inclusion lands where f ≠ g.

goal.alchemy: From the matching batch, reach the agreed reading.
goal.spellcraft: From the matching part, reach the agreed sign.
goal.abstract: Reach the value on which f and g agree.

afterSuccess.data: You included a record from the matching set, and BOTH queries returned the same country — that's the whole point of the equalizer: it's exactly the sub-object where the two parallel arrows agree (f∘e = g∘e). The mismatched inclusion landed where billing and shipping differ, so neither query reached the agreed answer.
afterSuccess.alchemy: You included a sample from the matching batch, and BOTH assays agreed — the equalizer is exactly where the two parallel arrows agree (f∘e = g∘e). The mismatched inclusion landed where they differ.
afterSuccess.spellcraft: You included a mote from the matching part, and BOTH readings agreed — the equalizer is exactly where the two parallel arrows agree (f∘e = g∘e). The mismatched inclusion landed where they differ.
afterSuccess.abstract: f∘e = g∘e: the equalizer inclusion lands precisely where f and g coincide, so either composite gives the same value. An inclusion missing the equalizer breaks the agreement.

reveal.summary: The equalizer of parallel f, g : A → B is the sub-object e : E → A picking out exactly where f and g agree, with f∘e = g∘e. It is the limit of the parallel pair — the universal 'where they agree'.
